bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; expanding the exemption for certain meals and drinks; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 297A.68, by adding subdivisions.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 297A.68, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 47.

Complimentary meals and beverages.

Meals and beverages, including alcoholic beverages, provided by a restaurant as defined under section 157.15, subdivision 12, to a customer at no cost to the customer are exempt.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2025.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 297A.68, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 48.

Employee food and drink.

Prepared food and beverages, excluding alcoholic beverages, purchased for and served to employees of a restaurant defined under section 157.15, subdivision 12, are exempt.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2025.
